Illustrate (via grids and arrangement descriptions), estimate (all stems ask for totals), area attribute (hints establish area as countable units), square figures (11 samples), rectangle figures (10 samples), square tile covering (all samples specify tiles), and tile units (all reference units) are all present and interconnected throughout the packet without gaps.

decomposition.reasoning: Each requirement appears in every sample or in a substantial representative subset. Illustrate is met through visual GridArea displays in read_mcq samples and textual array descriptions in all others. Estimate appears as the core task in every stem. Area attribute is established by consistent hint language. Both square and rectangle figures have dedicated sample representations. Square tile covering and tile units are named explicitly in stems, options, and hints across all twenty-two samples without exception or implied alternative measurement systems.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The packet includes diverse problem types: cloze format (seeds 42, 502, 602, 700, 702, 1001, 1002), multiple-choice (seeds 44, 500, 501, 600, 601, 605, 800, 901, 1000), and read-only MCQ with visuals (seeds 43, 45, 46, 606, 701, 900). Visual support ranges from present (GridArea in read_mcq) to absent in non-visual formats, providing flexible presentation modes.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All multiplication products remain within Grade 3 computational expectations, with the largest being 10×10=100. Scaling increases gradually from 2×2=4 to 10×10=100, allowing progressive difficulty. Seed 601 uses real-world meter-based measurements (2m by 3m) while most others use abstract tile counts, providing both concrete and symbolic representations appropriate for the grade.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Samples employ multiple experience modes (standard, hint_gated, mastery_drill, scaffolded), multiple formats (cloze, mcq, read_mcq), visual presentation strategies (visual grids for read_mcq samples), and thematic variations (generic, dance-themed, basketball-themed). This combination ensures learners encounter area estimation through varied pedagogical lenses and presentation contexts, supporting diverse learning pathways.
